description: An unpackaged Windows App SDK app repeatedly asks for a runtime that appears installed, based on https://github.com/microsoft/WindowsAppSDK/issues/4268.
prompt:
Some users install our desktop app and still get the Windows App Runtime prompt every time they start it. The bundled runtime installer says it completed successfully.

```
This application requires the Windows App Runtime
  Version 1.5
  (MSIX package version >= 5001.70.1338.0)

Event Viewer: ERROR 0x80070005: Bootstrapper initialization failed while looking for version 1.5
```
